entries.heading: EXPIRED COOPERATIVE NATIONAL FOREST PRODUCTS MARKETING PROGRAM
ancestors: Subtitle A—Repeal of Certain Forestry Programs
entries.text:
SEC. 8003. EXPIRED COOPERATIVE NATIONAL FOREST PRODUCTS MARKETING 
                          PROGRAM.

    Section 18 of the Cooperative Forestry Assistance Act of 1978 (16 
U.S.C. 2112) is repealed.
